title: Free things to do in Miami this October
igCaption:
Everything free in Miami this October 🆓

Every Wed: free movies at SoundScape Park, Miami Beach
All month: Giralda in Bloom umbrella art, Coral Gables
Oct 31: Red Bull Flugtag at Bayfront Park
Oct 31: HalloWYN block party, Wynwood Marketplace, 7pm–3am (RSVP for a free drink)

Which one are you going to? Tag who's coming with you.

#FreeMiami #MiamiEvents #MiamiHalloween #MiamiThingsToDo

scenes.text: Here's everything free in Miami this October. You don't have to spend a dollar.
scenes.caption: Here's everything free in Miami this October. You don't have to spend a dollar.

scenes.text: Every Wednesday, free movies are back at SoundScape Park on Miami Beach. The movie plays on the wall of the New World Center. Bring a blanket and snacks.
scenes.caption: Every Wednesday, free movies are back at SoundScape Park on Miami Beach. The movie plays on the wall of the New World Center. Bring a blanket and snacks.

scenes.text: In Coral Gables, hundreds of flower umbrellas hang over Giralda Plaza. It's called Giralda in Bloom. It's free, and it's up through October.
scenes.caption: In Coral Gables, hundreds of flower umbrellas hang over Giralda Plaza. It's called Giralda in Bloom. It's free, and it's up through October.

scenes.text: Halloween night, Red Bull Flugtag lands at Bayfront Park. Teams launch homemade flying machines off a twenty-two foot deck. It's free to watch.
scenes.caption: Halloween night, Red Bull Flugtag lands at Bayfront Park. Teams launch homemade flying machines off a 22-foot deck. It's free to watch.

scenes.text: Then keep going at HalloWYN. It's Wynwood Marketplace's free Halloween block party, from seven p.m. to three a.m. RSVP and you get a free welcome drink.
scenes.caption: Then keep going at HalloWYN. It's Wynwood Marketplace's free Halloween block party, from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. RSVP and you get a free welcome drink.
